about.title: La Quinta Car Accident Claims
about.longDescription: La Quinta's busiest roads — Washington Street, Highway 111, and Jefferson Street — see a steady stream of traffic from residents, seasonal visitors, and golf-cart and pedestrian activity near the resorts. In a recent year, the city logged 100 injury collisions and 144 injured people, with Friday afternoons between 2 and 4 p.m. showing the heaviest reporting. Whether your crash happened at a signalized intersection or during a lane change on a Highway 111 corridor, sorting out fault and dealing with insurance adjusters can feel overwhelming while you're trying to recover. LawProactive is a free service, not a law firm, that connects injured drivers, passengers, and pedestrians in La Quinta with an independent personal injury attorney who can evaluate what happened, help preserve evidence, and handle communication with insurers so you don't have to navigate it alone.

whyChoose.title: Why Talk to an Attorney Before the Insurer Calls Again

items.title: California's Two-Year Clock is Shorter Than You Think
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the crash date to file a car accident lawsuit, but that window shrinks to as little as six months if a government entity — like a public road authority on Highway 111 — may be responsible. An attorney can spot that issue early, before it costs you your claim.

items.title: Comparative Fault Means Every Detail Matters
items.desc: California uses pure comparative fault, so even if you're found partly responsible for a Washington Street collision, you can still recover damages reduced by your share of fault. Because insurers often try to shift blame onto you, having someone document the scene and witness accounts protects your share of any recovery.

items.title: No Cap on Non-Economic Damages, But No Fee Unless You Win
items.desc: California doesn't limit compensation for pain, suffering, and other non-economic losses in most car accident cases, which is exactly why insurers push hard to minimize claims early. Attorneys in the LawProactive network work on contingency, so there's no upfront cost and no fee unless you recover.

items.question: Should I give the other driver's insurance company a recorded statement after a crash on Highway 111?
items.answer: No — you're generally not required to give a recorded statement to the other driver's insurer, and doing so before speaking with an attorney can hurt your claim. Adjusters are trained to ask questions that minimize payouts, and your words can be used against you later. It's safer to let an attorney handle that communication on your behalf.

items.question: What if my accident happened at a busy Jefferson Street intersection during peak Friday traffic?
items.answer: Timing and location matter for gathering evidence — traffic camera footage, witness statements, and even signal timing records can disappear or become harder to obtain the longer you wait. An attorney can move quickly to request and preserve that evidence while it's still available. This is especially important at higher-traffic corridors where multiple vehicles or witnesses were involved.
